meta.title: Priest of Torm spell list
rules: Spell included if any of its spheres is a major-access sphere, or a minor-access sphere and the spell is 1st-3rd level (Cleric rule applied to this class's spheres).
Only spells whose Original Reference is PHB, PHB1, TOM, UA or HR are included (Cleric rule).
id matches the spell id in priest-spells.json.
castingTime, range and savingThrow are copied from priest-spells.json.
bonusSpells are separate from the normal selection: they do not use spell slots and are not chosen from the list above. The sheet shows each in the panel for its spell level, in its own section.
chooseOneGroup: spells sharing a group are alternatives; one use per day in total (owner).
Divination and protection sphere spells cast by this class have double duration (permanent and instantaneous unchanged).

No extension of allowed weapons is intended: Torm grants no additional weapons beyond those already allowed to the generic Cleric (blunt weapons only), so the god's allowedWeapons list is empty (owner).

God-specific spells for Torm (access 'god') are added regardless of sphere and reference: Compel, Hand of Torm, Bolt of Glory, Swordward (owner). Compel is also one of the bonus spells (once per day from level 5); both entries are kept.
meta.bonusSpellsNote: Wizard-list spells (Hold Portal, Mount, Power Word Stun, Power Word Blind) come from the wizard files; the rest from priest-spells.json. The owner chose the wizard Power Word, Stun.
meta.allowedWeaponsNote: No extension of allowed weapons is intended: Torm grants no additional weapons beyond those already allowed to the generic Cleric (blunt weapons only), so the god's allowedWeapons list is empty (owner).
